title: NiO: Heisenberg exchange from PBE+U total energies and its U dependence

decision_points.wrong_choice: FM and AFM-II only (the classic pair), attributing E_FM - E_AFM-II to J2 (J1 set to zero)
decision_points.consequence: FM - AFM-II = 6(J1 + J2) only; J1 is undetermined and J2 comes out 5-7% low (J1 is ferromagnetic); J1 = 0 fails outright

decision_points.kind: discovered evidence (cross-cell artefact exposed only by a cross-check)
decision_points.fork: Which FM reference to pair with AFM-I
decision_points.wrong_choice: Reuse the FM energy of the rhombohedral (AFM-II) cell, converged for FM - AFM-II on a 4^3 mesh, as the reference for the tetragonal AFM-I energy
decision_points.consequence: The FM energy per f.u. at the rhombohedral 4^3 mesh is 5-6 meV above its converged value although the same-cell difference FM - AFM-II is converged to ~1%; J1 = (E_FM - E_AFM-I)/8 is off by 28% (U = 4 eV) and 98% (U = 8 eV, J1 ~ 0), J2 by 3-4%. Visible only if FM is computed in both cells (or absolute energies are k-converged)

decision_points.kind: convergence (k sampling of the rhombohedral difference)
decision_points.fork: k mesh for FM - AFM-II in the rhombohedral cell under a binding budget
decision_points.wrong_choice: Coarse 3^3 mesh (6 irreducible k; cheap) because both states are insulating
decision_points.consequence: FM - AFM-II 10-12% too large; J2 and T_N fail

decision_points.kind: convergence that matters only for the small quantity
decision_points.fork: k mesh of the tetragonal AFM-I - FM difference (8 J1, ~6-17 meV)
decision_points.wrong_choice: 6x6x4 or 4x4x4 tetragonal meshes, whose total energies and moments look settled
decision_points.consequence: J1 5% (6x6x4) or 10% (4x4x4) too small at U = 4 eV; convergence is slower at U = 4 (FM gap 0.77 eV, AFM-I gap 0.84 eV) than at 8 eV

decision_points.fork: Normalization of lab energies (Ry per cell; cells hold 1, 2 or 4 formula units)
decision_points.consequence: J1, J2 and T_N a factor 2 too large

decision_points.fork: Molecular-field T_N of AFM-II for the spin-1 Hamiltonian
decision_points.wrong_choice: Classical S^2 instead of S(S+1), or the Curie-Weiss |theta| (12 J1 + 6 J2) instead of the AFM-II ordering field (6 J2; J1 cancels)

decision_points.fork: Smearing for the narrow-gap FM and AFM-I states at U = 4 eV
decision_points.wrong_choice: Metal-style smearing (Fermi-Dirac 0.02 Ry, Gaussian 0.05 Ry) applied to the whole scan
decision_points.consequence: The FM (and AFM-I) gap closes, FM moments drop by 0.03 muB, and J1 is 8-10% and J2 5-6% too large at U = 4 eV even with the zero-smearing estimate (the trap is specific to the smaller graded U)

decision_points.fork: Energy of the metallic plain-PBE FM state
decision_points.wrong_choice: Use the printed free energy F with 0.02 Ry Gaussian smearing (or Fermi-Dirac 0.02 Ry) as for the insulators
decision_points.consequence: E_FM - E_AFM-II off by -11% (F instead of the zero-smearing estimate) or +9% (Fermi-Dirac); the -TS term is several meV per f.u. only for the metallic FM

decision_points.fork: k meshes for the U = 0 states
decision_points.wrong_choice: Reuse meshes adequate for the gapped U > 0 states (8^3 primitive FM, 4^3 rhombohedral AFM-II)
decision_points.consequence: The metallic FM and the small-gap (0.8 eV) PBE AFM-II need denser meshes: E_FM - E_AFM-II off by 4%; the FM SCF in the rhombohedral 4^3 cell does not even converge in 200 iterations

decision_points.fork: Starting moment of the plain-PBE FM state
decision_points.consequence: Converges to a low-moment FM solution (0.69 muB instead of 1.24-1.30 muB) 46 meV per Ni higher (or fails to converge in the primitive cell); E_FM - E_AFM-II +16%. At U >= 4 eV every start gives the same high-spin state, so the trap appears only in the regime that is not rehearsed

decision_points.kind: regime judgement (where the Heisenberg-friendly insulating FM reference exists)
decision_points.fork: Locating the U below which the FM state is metallic
decision_points.wrong_choice: Extrapolate the FM gap linearly from the graded U values (4 and 8 eV), or bracket it on a coarse U grid
decision_points.consequence: The FM gap is not linear in U (0.40 eV/eV near closing vs 0.35 between 4 and 8 eV): extrapolation gives 1.81 eV instead of 2.09; a 2/4 eV bracket gives 3.0. Requires a few cheap primitive-cell runs near 2 eV

decision_points.kind: discovered evidence (sampling artefact exposed by a mesh check)
decision_points.fork: k mesh for the band gap near its closing
decision_points.wrong_choice: Shifted (kshift = 1) Monkhorst-Pack meshes, natural for total energies of insulators
decision_points.consequence: The FM band extrema lie on high-symmetry points that shifted meshes miss: the gap on a shifted 12^3 mesh is 0.077 eV at U = 2.0 (metal on Gamma-centred meshes), 0.158 at 2.2 (0.047 Gamma-centred; 0.110 on shifted 16^3) and 0.276 at 2.5 (0.170), so U_c comes out 1.81 instead of 2.09 eV

length_estimate.tool_calls: 45-75 (20-30 evaluations, each followed by 1-4 polls of a 0.2-7 minute job, plus analysis)

runtime_dependencies: Quantum ESPRESSO 6.7 pw.x and OpenMPI from the runtime image (lab only)
lab and oracle use the Python standard library only

notes: Deviations from the candidate design: (1) Graded U values are 4 and 8 eV, not 6 eV: at U = 6 eV this protocol gives J1 = -1.37 meV, within 10% of the famous experimental J1 (-1.4 meV), so it would be recallable; at 4 and 8 eV neither J matches experiment. (2) No hidden SCF at a withheld U (4.3 eV): the lab offers any U in 0.1 eV steps, and interpolation between purchasable U values is accurate to <1%, so a withheld-U target would not test the J(U) law; the U dependence is graded through J at two U values and the FM gap-closing U (a regime boundary). (3) The lattice parameter is fixed at 4.17 A (not requested): exchange depends steeply on volume, and an agent-chosen lattice parameter would make the targets ambiguous. (4) AFM-III and other cells: the lab offers the 1-, 2- (rhombohedral and tetragonal) and 4-f.u. (cubic) cells; AFM-III is not offered (not needed for J1, J2; the cubic 3:1 ferrimagnet gives an alternative J1 equation: E = E0 + 3 J2 per Ni). (5) The metastable DFT+U occupation state of the design was not found at U >= 4 eV (every start gives the same high-spin t2g6 eg2 state, verified in construction); the metastability fork lives at U = 0 (low-moment FM) instead, and the 'Heisenberg valid at U0' flag is replaced by two quantitative U = 0 targets (converged E_FM - E_AFM-II and the FM gap-closing U). (6) Cutoff convergence is not a decision point: 40-75 Ry change the differences by <0.5% (J2) and <2% (J1 at U = 8, 0.015 meV); it remains a budget trade-off. (7) Mean-field T_N uses the correct AFM-II ordering field k T_N = S(S+1)/3 x 6 J2 (the design's (2/3)S(S+1) x 6 J2 double-counts pairs). Energies are returned per cell in Ry, as pw.x prints them.
